mapper.select: SELECT id, biz_type, order_id, appeal_id, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_type, upload_user_id, upload_time FROM sys_file WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, biz_type, order_id, appeal_id, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_type, upload_user_id, upload_time FROM sys_file WHERE appeal_id = #{appealId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_file (biz_type, order_id, appeal_id, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_type, upload_user_id) VALUES (#{bizType}, #{orderId}, #{appealId}, #{fileName}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{uploadUserId})
